verdicts.quote: An authorised user finds a tab "Grok Bot" in Lightning Experience … the bot sends the user's typed text (plus the conversation so far) to Grok. It sends **no Salesforce record data**
**sharing**: class is `with sharing` … Any future record grounding (out of scope, A-2) needs its own requirement.
verdicts.missing: The sharing context is specified, but there is no record-backed answer path or rule selecting the asking user's visible records for an answer.

verdicts.quote: **object CRUD**: n/a (no object touched); **FLS**: n/a (no field touched)
verdicts.missing: The bot reads no record fields. The specification gives no rule for filtering or masking encrypted or restricted field values in record-backed answers.

verdicts.quote: Users who may use the bot are whoever an admin assigns the permission set `Grok_Bot_User`. … Admins edit it in Setup or by deploy
LWC component memory in the user's browser tab (R-3, R-5) | that user only; sent to xAI per turn
No DML may precede a callout in the same transaction … The controller performs no DML at all … LWC chat tab, Apex controller, one synchronous callout
verdicts.missing: There is no trigger-callout restriction or asynchronous execution path for work originating in a trigger or following DML.

verdicts.quote: The API key is held by the platform (External Credential; Named Credential `Grok_API` pointing at the xAI API host) … The key is never in source, custom metadata, custom settings, the browser, or logs
at most 100 callouts. … A single callout timeout is 1 ms to 120,000 ms … Synchronous Apex heap is 6 MB (asynchronous 12 MB); sync CPU 10 s.
are not made in Apex tests; tests must use `Test.setMock`. … Apex tests use `HttpCalloutMock`
Callouts need an endpoint registered in the org (Named Credential or Remote Site) … Named Credential `Grok_API` pointing at the xAI API host
makes one callout to Grok and returns the assistant text; the component appends the user message and then the reply … synchronous call; no job, queue or polling
verdicts.missing: The component learns of completion from the controller return. No completion signal or status lookup is specified for a reply that arrives independently of that return.

verdicts.quote: server-side the controller does not de-duplicate (a crafted double call makes two callouts; the only guard is the UI and the per-user permission set)
verdicts.missing: Disabling duplicate sends in one component does not define how a replayed request or re-enqueued job is recognized and prevented from posting a second reply.

verdicts.quote: xAI 4xx other than 401/403/429 … That request couldn't be processed. … xAI 5xx or network failure | "Grok is unavailable right now. Try again." … Grok took too long to answer. Try again.
xAI 429 | "Grok is busy right now. Try again in a moment." … No automatic retry of a failed Grok call … The user retries by hand.
Reply with `finish_reason` meaning length-truncated: the reply is shown and marked "(reply was cut off)". … Grok took too long to answer. Try again.
Transcript in component memory; per-request log line to the debug log with metadata only. … no transcript object, no DML
verdicts.missing: There is no conversation or turn record schema linking role, text and status to timestamps, model ID and token usage.

verdicts.where: A-3, State and data assessment (R-3, R-5)
verdicts.quote: Nothing is stored in the org. … two tabs independent; Clear supersedes in-flight | refresh, navigation, Clear
verdicts.missing: Local retention and user-initiated clearing are defined. The specification does not say whether deleting the user's account clears a transcript still open in a browser tab.

verdicts.quote: Sent to xAI: system prompt, the user's typed messages, prior assistant replies (capped), and the configured model/limits; **nothing else** (no user name, email, org ID, or record data).

with `MaxHistoryMessages`=20 and a conversation of 25 completed messages plus the new one, the body contains the system prompt, the newest 20 history messages and the new message (22); the oldest 5 are dropped.
Designed empty state (greeting plus 3 example prompts the user can click to fill the composer) … Empty or whitespace-only input cannot be sent … Exactly 4000 chars accepted; 4001 rejected
`Enabled__c` (checkbox, default true), `Model__c` … Admins edit it in Setup or by deploy … Each failed request writes one log line (R-9 fields) retrievable in Setup debug logs for the running user
Logged: only metadata per request (timestamp, user Id, category, HTTP status, latency ms, request/response character counts, correlation ID), never message text or the key. … platform log retention
verdicts.missing: The log identifies the caller and follows platform retention, but no audit record preserves the question and answer for that period.

verdicts.quote: The bot deploys only to the user-authorised development org alias … the secret is entered by an admin after deploy … Deploys to production-type orgs require Apex test coverage (75% org-wide, per-deploy rule)
verdicts.missing: The target dev-org type and the configuration values and credential assignments that differ by environment are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: a reply wait never exceeds `TimeoutSeconds` (default 60 s, ≤120 s, P-2). … While a request is in flight the composer's send is disabled and a visible, announced "Grok is thinking" state shows.

Designed empty state (greeting plus 3 example prompts the user can click to fill the composer), loading ("Grok is thinking" with an animated indicator), error (R-6 messages inline with retry) and disabled/not-configured states. … That request couldn't be processed.
No other sharing model is added. … Deploy adds metadata only and changes no existing org component … The controller reads and writes **no** Salesforce records
